event.firm_key: BOBS RED MILL NATURAL FOODS INC
event.recalling_firm: Bob's Red Mill Natural Foods, Inc.
event.distribution_pattern: Distributed in CA, IL, FL, MI, NH, NJ, NY, OR, and TX.

products.product_description: Bob's Red Mill 100% Whole Wheat Bread Mix, Item 1674C194, packaged in flexible packaging bag, 4 bags to a cardboard case, each bag weighs 19 oz. The UPC is 0 39978 00667 7. The label on the FRONT side of a package is read in parts: "***Bob's Red Mill ***100% WHOLE WHEAT BREAD MIX***". The label on the BACK side of a package is read in parts: "***INGREDIENT: Bread Mix: Whole Grain Buckwheat, Garbanzo Bean Flour, Potato Starch, Cornstarch, Sunflower Seeds, Sesame Seeds, Whole Grain Sorghum Flour, Tapioca Flour, Cocoa Powder, Cane Sugar, Fava Bean Flour, Dried Molasses (Molasses, Maltodextrin, Silicon Dioxide), Xanthan Gum, Caraway Seeds, Sea Salt, Whole Grain Teff, Potato Flour, Onion Powder, Guar Gum, Soy Lecithin. Yeast Packet: Yeast Sorbitan Monostearate, Ascorbic Acid***".
products.code_info: Best by 16 JUL 2019. 249490 05:24 14 01 2018 (05:24 stands for production time and 14 01 2018 stands for production date of January 14, 2018)
products.reason_for_recall: 100% Whole Wheat Bread Mix is recalled due to undeclared wheat in the label on the back side of the package.
